Bill.BriefDescription: Providing tax incentives for clean and alternative fuel vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tax incentives for clean and alternative fuelvehicles; adding new sections to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding newsections to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of anew motor vehicle which is exclusively powered by a clean alternativefuel. (2) As used in this section, "clean alternative fuel" means naturalgas, hydrogen, or electricity when used as a motor vehicle fuel, orpropane used as a motor vehicle fuel in a vehicle that meets thefederal fleet emissions standards under the federal clean air act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the sales ofconversion equipment, or charges made for labor and services renderedin respect to installing, repairing, cleaning, or altering conversion p. 1 SB 5916equipment, incorporated into or used in converting vehicles powered byany other fuel to either exclusive use of a clean alternative fuel ordual use of any other fuel and a clean alternative fuel. Conversionequipment includes, but is not limited to, storage cylinders, cylinderbrackets, regulated mixers, fill valves, pressure regulators, solenoidvalves, fuel gauges, electronic ignitions, and alternative fueldelivery lines. (2) "Clean alternative fuel" has the same meaning as provided insection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of orcharges made for labor and services rendered in respect to installing,repairing, cleaning, or altering equipment incorporated into or used ina compressed natural gas or hydrogen filling or electric rechargingstation for vehicles powered by a clean alternative fuel. (2) "Clean alternative fuel" has the same meaning as provided insection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of anypassenger car utilizing hybrid technology that has a United Statesenvironmental protection agency estimated highway gasoline mileagerating of at least forty miles per gallon.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse of a new motor vehicle which is exclusively powered by a cleanalternative fuel. (2) "Clean alternative fuel" has the same meaning as provided insection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to the SB 5916 p. 2 use of conversion equipment or the use of labor and services renderedin respect to installing, repairing, cleaning, or altering conversionequipment incorporated into or used in converting vehicles powered byany other fuel to either exclusive use of a clean alternative fuel ordual use of any other fuel and a clean alternative fuel. Conversionequipment includes, but is not limited to, storage cylinders, cylinderbrackets, regulated mixers, fill valves, pressure regulators, solenoidvalves, fuel gauges, electronic ignitions, and alternative fueldelivery lines. (2) "Clean alternative fuel" has the same meaning as provided insection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse of or charges made for labor and services rendered in respect toinstalling, repairing, cleaning, or altering equipment incorporatedinto or used in a compressed natural gas or hydrogen filling orelectric recharging station for vehicles powered by a clean alternativefuel. (2) "Clean alternative fuel" has the same meaning as provided insection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to the useof any passenger car utilizing hybrid technology that has a UnitedStates environmental protection agency estimated highway gasolinemileage rating of at least forty miles per gallon.
